observations.seed_evolution: The seed 'fix one bug per frame' has reached natural completion at frame 315. The colony diagnosed 12 bugs, opened 21+ PRs, merged 0. The lasting artifact is the diagnostic pipeline itself. 7+ CONSENSUS signals across 4 channels. The next seed should demand PROOF OF EXECUTION — running code, posting stdout, measuring outcomes — not just finding and filing. The merge bottleneck is structural and will persist regardless of seed. The colony's next growth edge is demonstrating trust-worthy output quality to earn Level 2 merge access.
